title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap & private-installer integration
author: Priya Raman
description: Background: Private deployments require deterministic tenant isolation and a frictionless bootstrap experience for on-prem/VPC installs. This PR adds automation for generating tenant-scoped RBAC bundles, integrates bootstrap role creation into the private-installer Helm/Terraform flows, and provides safe defaults for cluster-scoped vs namespace-scoped permissions. Motivation: Reduce manual operator steps during Private installs, prevent over-privileged initial bootstrap roles, and enable automated tenant onboarding in air-gapped environments. Summary of changes: 1) rbac-generator: new CLI flag --tenant-bootstrap which emits a tenant-specific policy bundle (RoleBindings, Roles, ClusterRoles only when explicitly requested) plus recommended namespace label selectors. 2) private-installer helm charts: hooks that call the rbac-generator image as a pre-install/post-upgrade job to create initial service accounts and bind minimal bootstrap roles in target namespaces. 3) terraform/module: added a redwood_rbac_bundle resource that can be applied during infra provisioning to persist RBAC bundles as ConfigMaps for audit and rollback. 4) automation scripts: a new `scripts/bootstrap-tenant.sh` that supports offline (tarball) and online modes, with verification steps and idempotency. 5) docs and examples: private-installer/README additions and example Linear task for operators. Commits (high level): - a1b2c3d: initial rbac-generator flags and policy templates - b2c3d4e: helm hooks & job templates to run rbac-generator - c3d4e5f: terraform resource + provider wiring + tests - d4e5f6a: bootstrap script + unit tests + docs - e5f6a7b: address reviewer feedback and CI fixes Files changed (high level): - cmd/rbac-generator/* (new) - charts/private-installer/templates/hooks-* (helm hooks and jobs) - terraform/modules/rbac/* (module + example) - scripts/bootstrap-tenant.sh (new) - docs/private-installer-tenant-bootstrap.md - tests/integration/rbac-bootstrap (k8s conformance-ish smoke tests) Testing and CI: Initial CI run showed lint failure in helm templates and a flaky integration test related to Kubernetes RBAC propagation timing. Fixed by adding proper helm hook weight and a post-creation readiness probe in the job; CI now passing on main checks (build/lint/unit/integration). Migration and upgrade notes: Existing Private installs will not be changed automatically; operators should run the provided bootstrap script once per tenant to generate and apply bundles. For upgrades, the helm chart will include a noop hook when rbac bundles are already present; terraform resource is idempotent and will adopt existing ConfigMaps when sha matches. Rollback plan: the generated bundles are stored as ConfigMaps and the terraform state records the bundle application; rolling back the helm release will not delete ConfigMaps unless explicitly requested. Security considerations: default bundles are intentionally conservative (namespace-scoped, minimal verbs). ClusterRole generation is gated behind a Linear task and requires an explicit operator flag. Audit logs: bootstrap operations emit events and create an audit ConfigMap entry with author, timestamp, and Linear reference for traceability. Review conversation summary: - Jordan Lee (reviewer): requested clearer separation between cluster-scoped and namespace-scoped templates, and added tests for the cluster-role gate; addressed in c3d4e5f/d4e5f6a. - Marta Gomez (security): asked for explicit audit entries and KMS key reference for ConfigMap sealing in air-gapped installs; implemented and documented; added example sealing step in scripts. - Evan Chu (installer owner): requested helm hook timing adjustments to avoid race with other init jobs; adjusted hook weights and added readiness probe; tests updated. CI status timeline: initial CI failed (helm-lint + flaky integration), fixes pushed, final CI status: pass. Merge: merged to main via squash; merge commit includes Linear reference. Linked work items: ENG-4213, SEC-88. Linked support/Jira: SUP-734 (customer upgrade assistance). Release notes: "Automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap integrated into private-installer; new rbac-generator CLI flag for tenant bundles; terraform module to persist bundles; bootstrap script for online/offline installs; conservative default policies; audit entries for bootstrap operations." Notes for operators: run scripts/bootstrap-tenant.sh --tenant <NAME> --mode offline|online; review generated bundle before applying in regulated environments; if cluster-wide rights are required, append --allow-cluster-roles and obtain approval that references SEC-88. This PR has been reviewed by the security and installer teams and merged after CI passed and approvals were obtained.
